name: brainstorm
description: Explore ideas, compare distinct alternatives with concrete examples, and refine a direction through collaborative brainstorming across topics.

interface.longDescription: Develop ideas through conversation: establish the frame, explore distinct alternatives with concrete examples, compare their consequences, and refine a direction. Tables, diagrams, research, and independent subagents are optional when useful and supported by the host. Applies across topics and stays exploratory until implementation is requested.
defaultPrompt: Use Brainstorm to explore alternatives for my idea and compare the tradeoffs with concrete examples.
Use Brainstorm to compare a simple approach with two distinct alternatives and help me choose a direction.
